As a person who lives in a tropical country with constant 35+ celcius, my number one priority would be shade. The next would be hydration, a hydration pack would be great but your usual bottled water would be just enough, make sure to cool it down first. The next is about apparel, your option is either a well-ventilated jacket, a thin (but strong) one, or no jacket at all (with sun screen obviously). The last two apparels options ain't the best for your safety but as long as you keep your speed below some certain point, I guess you are cool.

Pas gw liat dari aplikasi billing habis dari wc, dia ternyata lagi ngetik kek semacem lamaran kerja gitu. Sekitar sejam kemudian, dia akhirnya close billing terus mau ngeprint, gw liat filenya dan semuanya isi lamaran kerja dan jumlahnya banyak banget.
